title: APS-VLA: Action-Guided and Future-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.13030v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have demonstrated strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet processing dense visual tokens often incurs high inference latency. Visual token pruning offers a practical way to reduce this cost, but identifying a compact set of tokens that preserves reliable action generation remains challenging. Existing methods largely rely on static or immediate heuristic cues to estimate token importance. We introduce APS-VLA, a framework that learns visual token selection from robot demonstrations while keeping the pretrained VLA backbone frozen. A lightweight Decision Influence Estimator scores tokens conditioned on current visual observations, language instructions, and robot proprioception. Its training combines two complementary signals: action supervision matches both the full-input policy predictions and demonstrated actions, while an auxiliary visual transition objective uses demonstrated actions t

translated_title: APS-VLA：面向高效视觉-语言-动作模型的动作引导与未来感知的令牌剪枝方法
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在机器人操作任务中已展现出强大的泛化能力，然而处理密集的视觉令牌往往带来较高的推理延迟。视觉令牌剪枝为降低这一开销提供了一条实用途径，但如何挑选出一组紧凑的令牌、同时保证可靠的动作生成，仍然具有挑战性。现有方法大多依赖静态或即时性的启发式线索来估计令牌的重要性。我们提出了 APS-VLA，这是一个在保持预训练 VLA 骨干网络冻结的前提下，从机器人演示数据中学习视觉令牌选择的框架。一个轻量级的决策影响估计器基于当前视觉观测、语言指令和机器人本体感知对令牌进行打分。其训练结合了两种互补的信号：动作监督使剪枝后的策略预测同时匹配全输入策略的预测结果与演示动作，同时一个辅助性的视觉转移目标利用演示动作……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: APS-VLA 在冻结预训练 VLA 骨干网络的前提下，通过一个结合动作监督与未来感知视觉转移目标的轻量级决策影响估计器，从机器人演示中学习视觉令牌剪枝，在显著降低推理延迟的同时保证可靠的动作生成。
en_tdlr: APS-VLA learns visual token pruning from robot demonstrations with a frozen VLA backbone, using a lightweight Decision Influence Estimator trained with action supervision and a future-aware visual transition objective, thereby reducing inference latency while preserving reliable action generation.
